overview: The Medford City Council met to honor the memory of Len Gliona, approve various fire department capital appropriations, accept a $450,000 state grant for archaeological work in Medford Square, and pass a new vacant building ordinance on first reading.

items.title: Lenny Gliona Memorial Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences and commemorating the life of former City Council candidate and political follower Len Gliona.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the meeting records from April 28, 2026, and accepted several committee reports.

items.title: CDBG Action Plan Fiscal Year 2027 Public Hearing
items.summary: Approved the Program Year 2026 Annual Action Plan for the submission of CDBG funds to HUD following a public hearing.

items.title: Board Appointment for Roberta Cameron
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Roberta Cameron to the Historic District Commission.

items.title: Softball Tournament Food Truck Permits
items.summary: Approved food truck permits for All Belgian Waffles and Kona Ice for an upcoming youth softball tournament.

items.title: Fire Department Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved capital stabilization fund appropriations for a new fire department ladder truck, equipment outfitting, a fire chief vehicle, and two fire prevention vehicles.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendment: Assistant Network Administrator
items.summary: Approved a personnel ordinance amendment updating the classification and increasing weekly hours for the Assistant Network Administrator.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendment: Non-Union Wage Adjustment
items.summary: Approved a 2.5% cost-of-living salary increase for non-union city personnel.

items.title: Proposed Vacant Building Ordinance
items.summary: Voted to sever the proposal, referring the old zoning repeal to the Community Development Board and passing the new vacant building ordinance on first reading.

items.title: Medford Square Redevelopment Project Grant
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a $450,000 Mass Development Grant to fund excavation and archaeological work at the Medford Square redevelopment site.

items.title: Unfinished Business Files
items.summary: Received and placed on file two old papers concerning other corridors zoning and a BJ's Wholesale Club report.

items.title: Deployment Announcement
items.summary: Councilor Leming announced his upcoming six-month deployment with the Navy Reserves.
